nodes.label: ERM System (Enterprise Risk Management web app)
nodes.rationale: Web system for risk registration and assessment, mitigation actions, approval workflow and reporting, built with Django and PostgreSQL; Persian RTL UI, run with Docker on the organisation's internal server.

nodes.label: Docker Compose prod profile (db, web, monitoring, nginx)
nodes.rationale: web runs Django under gunicorn and auto-runs migrate and collectstatic on start; nginx on port 80 proxies to web and serves static files; db is PostgreSQL 17.

nodes.label: monitoring service / monitor_risks command
nodes.rationale: Hourly monitoring of risk, acceptance and evidence expiry, reviews and internal notices. In development run `monitor_risks --watch --interval 3600`; without --watch it runs once, suitable for cron; in production the monitoring container does it after web is ready.

nodes.label: check_schema management command
nodes.rationale: Diagnoses ProgrammingError 'column/relation does not exist' by comparing the database to models and migrations, naming missing or extra columns/tables, unapplied migrations, and applied migrations whose files no longer exist.

nodes.label: Pushed migrations are never regenerated or edited
nodes.rationale: A migration pushed on any branch (even unmerged) is never rebuilt or edited; every model change gets a new migration, because a database that already ran the old version treats it as applied and would never run the new version.

nodes.label: React frontend (frontend/, served at /app/)
nodes.rationale: Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind and Radix, reading the Django API (/api/). Pages are migrated one by one; until a page is migrated the menu opens the Django page and says so. Management report and Django admin remain classic pages. Dev mode needs Django runserver first, then `npm run dev` on port 5173 proxying everything else to Django; `npm run build` produces the bundle Django serves.

nodes.label: API form/page bridge (/api/forms/, /api/pages/)
nodes.rationale: /api/forms/ and /api/pages/ execute the same Django view of each page (apps/api/bridge.py), so permissions, validation, messages, audit and post-save redirect stay identical to the Django page. Adding a form means one line in apps/api/bridge_pages.py and one route in frontend/src/app/routes.tsx.

nodes.label: Menu groups named after methodology stages
nodes.rationale: Menu groups (workbench, risk identification, assessment, treatment, questionnaire, organisation catalog, system administration) are defined in apps/api/session.py; the Django menu in templates/base.html has the same groups, so every change must be made in both.

nodes.label: Login redirect to SPA (/app/login/, ?classic=1 fallback)
nodes.rationale: Once the frontend is built, /accounts/login/ forwards to /app/login/ which uses the same Django form and audit trail; the old login page stays reachable with ?classic=1.

nodes.label: SPA CSP with Trusted Types and per-request nonce
nodes.rationale: Django serves the SPA with CSP, Trusted Types and a fresh nonce per request; `npm run dev` does not enforce this policy, so final verification is done on the production build or via Playwright tests.

nodes.label: Frontend checks (lint, Vitest + axe, Playwright e2e)
nodes.rationale: `npm run test:e2e` builds the UI and serves it via e2e/server.mjs exactly as Django would (same CSP), on desktop and mobile in both themes with axe; API responses are test fixtures (src/test/fixtures.ts) and the app itself has no demo data. PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome supports old macOS.

nodes.label: Settings modules (base, dev, prod)
nodes.rationale: config/settings/base.py shared (DEBUG off), dev.py for manage.py and pytest locally (DEBUG on), prod.py for gunicorn and the Docker container; override via DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE.

nodes.label: Project structure (config, apps, frontend, templates, docker, docs)
nodes.rationale: apps/ holds core, accounts, organization, workcalendar, audit, catalog, risks, actions, workflow, reports and api (the React API); templates/ and static/ hold the base template, Vazirmatn font, RTL Bootstrap and htmx; docs/ holds business rules.

nodes.label: Version 5 compliance and monitoring (docs/v5-logic-changes.md)
nodes.rationale: Management report at /reports/, monitoring notices at /actions/notices/ and review tasks in My Work; logic changes, document references, example contradictions, tests and migration guide are in docs/v5-logic-changes.md.
